description: Seven volunteers in METU DF Kayseri School ambitious to making the world a better place.
summary: UrbanHeat is an AI-integrated data analysis website. The main goal of UrbanHeat is to simplify and model complex and scientific statistics about climate change and global warming in order to help everyone understand them. This increases the awareness of the society as the effects of these conditions are not easily observable. The website aims to collect viable climate data from organisations such as NASA and to let users compare, use, and understand statistics in a simplified way. As of start, we have determined four target cities in Europe, especially near the Mediterranean. These cities include Tirana with its location on an inland basin, Marseille with its comparatively organised urban centre and major harbours, Istanbul as it connects Asia and Europe, having more than 16 million in population, and Mostar, which we have designated as our pilot city. There are various characteristics these cities have, such as having accessible and useful data, experiencing observable climate change results, and having different geographical and demographic conditions. Mostar especially is important as it offers significant temperature differences on a relatively compact urban space and has strong field data. UrbanHeat offers solutions to problems these cities face by raising awareness about climate change, as it makes the slight changes observable, leading to people changing their lifestyles and questioning how big actors affect our climate.
details:
Title: AI-integrated climate change data analysis website.

Main objective: Simplify and visualise complex and scientific data about climate change and global warming in order to help everyone understand them.

Public benefits: Increasing the awareness of the society as the effects of these conditions are not easily observable.

Target cities: Tirana, Marseille, Istanbul, Mostar (for now.)

Technical information: JavaScript, HTML, CSS languages. Visual Studio Code. Built-in LM. (Is not included in the Drive link as it is supposed to run locally on a different machine.) 3060 GPU as server during AI tests.
